response.query: Which augmentation and loss re-weighting strategies most improve detection of flames <1 m2 and reduce small-object false negatives?
response.answer: Data augmentation with synthetic data and loss re-weighting strategies improve detection of small flames. YOLOv8 and adaptive modality learning networks show the best results. Reducing false negatives is achieved through specialized training techniques.
